name: Aneth's P1 adminmech droid
description: The human Aneth, co-owner of the Mina-Rau General Store on the planet Mina-Rau, owned a shabby P1 adminmech droid with red and white plating. In 4 BBY, the droid rolled round the store babbling while Aneth, her spouse Kellen, and their daughter Beela unloaded a delivery of supplies.
